title: Matthew Bible Quiz - Chapter 5
description: Ten questions on Matthew 5: the Beatitudes and the opening of the Sermon on the Mount.

questions.text: Where was Jesus when he began to teach his disciples?
questions.explanation: Seeing the crowds, Jesus went up on the mountain, sat down, and his disciples came to him.

answers.text: In a boat on the lake

questions.text: "Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is..."
questions.explanation: Jesus said theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.

questions.text: "Blessed are the meek, for they will..."
questions.explanation: The meek will inherit the earth.

questions.text: "Blessed are the pure in heart, for they will..."
questions.explanation: The pure in heart will see God.
Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.

questions.text: Jesus told his disciples, "You are the ___ of the earth."
questions.explanation: Jesus said, "You are the salt of the earth," and warned that salt that loses its flavor is good for nothing.

questions.text: What cannot be hidden, according to Jesus?
questions.explanation: "A city located on a hill can't be hidden," Jesus said, telling his disciples to let their light shine.

questions.text: What did Jesus say about the law and the prophets?
questions.explanation: Jesus said he had not come to destroy the law or the prophets, but to fulfill them.

questions.text: What did Jesus say to do if someone strikes you on the right cheek?
questions.explanation: Jesus said not to resist an evil person, but to turn the other cheek also.

answers.text: Strike back at him in return
Take the matter to the elders

questions.text: What did Jesus tell his hearers to do for their enemies?
questions.explanation: Jesus said, "Love your enemies, bless those who curse you, do good to those who hate you, and pray for those who mistreat you."

answers.text: Avoid them at all costs and leave
Love them and pray for those who persecute them
Report them to the local judge
